description: This file defines a class `TransformationXImages` within the PdfSharp library, specifically in the drawing snippets namespace. It contains code to render various image transformations, including rotations, scaling, shearing, and combinations thereof, on a graphics surface. The class is used for demonstrating image transformation techniques using the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: TransformationXImages
classes.description: A snippet class demonstrating various image transformation techniques such as rotation, scaling, shearing, and translation within the PDFsharp graphics context.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Overrides the base method to render a set of image transformations on the provided XGraphics object, illustrating different transformation effects.
